notes.title: Have You Heard About "Just A Shadow Game"? A Vietnamese Deckbuilding Roguelike Where You Perform Rituals to Challenge the Devil!
notes.notes:
A unique deckbuilding roguelike with a dark D&D twist—where the Devil himself is the Game Master. Perform sinister rituals, summon dark forces, and manipulate fate in a world of blood and bone. Do you have what it takes to outplay the master of the game?
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456690/Just_A_Shadow_Game_Demo/

notes.title: Bad Parenting 1 Officially Released!
notes.notes:
[b]The wait is over – Bad Parenting 1 is now officially available on Steam![/b]

What's new in the Steam version?
Added Fanart Exhibition, a 3D environment decorated with your fanart. You can walk freely in this environment.
Added 4 different graphic filters and brightness setting.

A huge thank you to our community and everyone who supported us from the start. We couldn’t have made it here without your feedback, encouragement, and love for this project.


Bad Parenting 2 will be announced soon!
